title: Driving past Bennewitz's Thunder Corporation on the way to Sandia

tellings.quote: to drive into Sandia Lab every morning right past Paul Bennewitz's office.

plain: John Brandenburg, a scientist who worked at Sandia, a national laboratory in Albuquerque, New Mexico, says that in the 1980s he drove past the office of Paul Bennewitz's company, Thunder Corporation, every morning on his way to work. He tells Michels this himself, as a detail of where he was while the Bennewitz story was going on.
